smtp.title: Email server (SMTP)
smtp.description: Set with environment variables of the instance. This page is read-only.
smtp.allowedDomainsHint: Sender identities on these domains send as themselves; others are sent on their behalf.

missing.title: No email server yet.
missing.body: Automations cannot send email and the email channel of notifications is hidden. The instance operator sets these variables, then restarts the API and the worker:
missing.docs: Details: “Docker Compose” environment variables in the self-hosting documentation (docs/SPEC.md §20).

test.hint_one: Sends a test email to {{email}}. {{count, number}} test left this minute.
test.hint_other: Sends a test email to {{email}}. {{count, number}} tests left this minute.

sent.title: Connection works.
sent.body: A test email was sent to {{to}} at {{time}}.

authFailed.title: The server refused to sign in.
authFailed.hint: Check the user name and password in SMTP_URL.

tlsFailed.title: The secure connection (TLS) failed.
tlsFailed.hint: Check the port and the scheme (smtps:// for TLS at once, smtp:// for STARTTLS) and the server certificate.

connectionFailed.title: Could not connect to the server.
connectionFailed.hint: Check the host name, the port and any firewall between Cellhive and the email server.

timeout.title: The server did not answer in time.
timeout.hint: The server may be overloaded or blocked by a firewall. Try again in a few minutes.

temporary.title: The server refused the email for now.
temporary.hint: This is usually temporary. Try again in a few minutes.

rejected.title: The server refused the email.
rejected.hint: Check that the server accepts the sender address of SMTP_FROM.

hostNotAllowed.title: The server address is not allowed.
hostNotAllowed.hint: The host resolves to a blocked address.

unknown.title: The test failed for an unknown reason.
unknown.hint: Try again; if it keeps failing, check the API and worker logs.

limits.title: Limits in force
limits.description: The instance operator can change them with environment variables.
limits.perHour: Emails per hour for the organization
limits.testsValue_one: {{count, number}} per minute for each person
limits.testsValue_other: {{count, number}} per minute for each person

footer.title: Footer of automation emails
footer.description: The footer tells recipients that the email was sent automatically.
footer.requiredHint: Every automation email has a Minimal or Full footer.
footer.author_choiceHint: Allows “None” when sending directly through a verified sender identity.

locked.title: Locked by the instance
locked.body: The instance sets EMAIL_AUTOMATION_FOOTER=required. The instance operator can change it to org to let each organization decide.

footer.org: The instance sets EMAIL_AUTOMATION_FOOTER=org, so the organization decides. Emails from the system sender or sent on behalf of an identity always have a footer.
footer.minimal: Minimal footer: <q>This email was sent automatically by Cellhive of {{org}}.</q>

signature.title: Default signature
signature.description: Used for emails sent by the system sender. Sender identities have their own signature.

systemSender.title: System sender for automations
systemSender.label: Allow automations to send as {{from}}
systemSender.labelNoSmtp: Allow automations to send with the system sender
systemSender.hint: Turn off to make every automation email go through a verified sender identity.
systemSender.usage_one: {{count, number}} automation uses it ({{enabled, number}} turned on).
systemSender.usage_other: {{count, number}} automations use it ({{enabled, number}} turned on).
systemSender.savedOn: Saved: automations may send with the system sender.
systemSender.savedOff: Saved: the system sender is turned off.

dialog.title: Turn off the system sender?
dialog.body_one: {{count, number}} automation sends with the system sender ({{enabled, number}} turned on). After turning it off, its email steps fail until a sender identity is chosen.
dialog.body_other: {{count, number}} automations send with the system sender ({{enabled, number}} turned on). After turning it off, their email steps fail until a sender identity is chosen.

identities.title: Sender identities
identities.description: Addresses such as hr@ or it@ so automations send email on behalf of a department.

audience.title: Who sees this page
audience.body: Owners and admins of the organization. Other members opening this link get the page not found.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Files automation emails may carry from attachment fields. Only files people can download are sent.
attachments.filesHint: At most {{max, number}} (limit of this server).
attachments.sizeHint: Original files, at most {{max, number}} MB (limit of this server).
attachments.range: Enter a whole number from 1 to {{max, number}}.
attachments.note: An email over these limits is not sent: its step fails, no file is dropped.
